U8: Flink processor for streaming ML abstractions.

technical_and_design_decisions: Target Spring Cloud Stream 4.0 (Spring Boot 3.x, Java 17) as the baseline framework version.
Implement all sink modules as Spring Cloud Stream functional consumers (java.util.function.Consumer) using the functional programming model.
Use the existing Spring Cloud Stream Binder for AWS Kinesis (spring-cloud-stream-binder-aws-kinesis) for the Kinesis sink module.

For the Flink processor, leverage Spring Cloud Stream's Flink binder (spring-cloud-stream-binder-flink) to embed Flink DataStream jobs within a Spring Boot application, enabling streaming ML abstractions via Flink ML.
Design the Job DSL as a fluent API on top of Spring Batch's JobBuilder/StepBuilder, providing a domain-specific language for batch workflow orchestration.

Port XD modules (Log, field-value-counter, aggregate-counter, gauge, rich-gauge) by adapting their core logic to Spring Cloud Stream's consumer model, replacing XD-specific module configuration with Spring Boot configuration properties.
Each module will be a separate Maven module under a common parent POM, following Spring Cloud Stream's naming conventions (e.g., spring-cloud-stream-module-kinesis-sink).
Integration testing will use Testcontainers for Kafka, LocalStack for Kinesis, and an embedded Flink cluster.
Documentation will be written in Asciidoc and integrated into the Spring Cloud Stream reference documentation.
Modules will be published to the Spring Maven repository via the standard Spring release process.
assumptions: The developer has full access to the Spring XD source code for reference during porting.
The Spring Cloud Stream Kinesis binder is stable and compatible with the target Spring Cloud Stream version.
A compatible Flink binder version exists for the target Spring Cloud Stream version.
The team has prior experience with Spring Cloud Stream, Spring Batch, and Apache Flink.
No changes to the Spring Cloud Stream core framework are required to support these modules.
Effort estimates represent ideal work-hours for a single experienced developer, excluding meetings and administrative overhead.
The Log sink simply logs incoming message payloads at a configurable log level.
The metric sinks (field-value-counter, aggregate-counter, gauge, rich-gauge) compute and expose metrics via Micrometer, similar to their XD counterparts.
The Job DSL is focused on batch job orchestration, not streaming pipeline definition.
The Flink processor module will provide a set of pre-built streaming ML operators (e.g., feature transformation, model inference) using Flink ML.

activities.activity_description: Create parent POM, define module structure, configure CI/CD pipelines, set up common dependencies (Spring Cloud Stream, Spring Boot, test libraries), and establish coding standards.

activities.activity_name: Kinesis Sink Module - Design and Implementation
activities.activity_description: Design the Kinesis sink module architecture, implement the consumer function using the Kinesis binder, handle configuration properties (stream name, AWS credentials, serialization), and implement error handling and retry logic.
Write unit tests for the consumer logic, and integration tests using Testcontainers with LocalStack to verify end-to-end message consumption from a Kinesis stream.

activities.activity_name: Log Sink Module - Port from XD
activities.activity_description: Analyze the XD Log module source code, adapt the logging logic to a Spring Cloud Stream Consumer bean, map XD module options to Spring Boot configuration properties, and implement the sink.
Write unit tests for log formatting and level configuration, and integration tests verifying message consumption and logging output.

activities.activity_name: Job DSL Module - Design and Implementation
activities.activity_description: Design the Job DSL fluent API, implement core DSL constructs (job, step, flow, decision), integrate with Spring Batch's JobBuilder/StepBuilder, provide configuration for job repository and transaction management, and implement sample workflows.

activities.activity_name: Job DSL Module - Testing and Documentation
activities.activity_description: Write unit tests for DSL constructs, integration tests executing sample batch jobs, and create Asciidoc documentation with examples.

activities.activity_name: Field-Value-Counter Sink Module - Port from XD
activities.activity_description: Analyze XD field-value-counter module, port the field-value counting logic to a Spring Cloud Stream consumer, expose metrics via Micrometer, and map configuration options.
Unit tests for counting logic, integration tests verifying metric updates on message consumption.

activities.activity_name: Aggregate-Counter Sink Module - Port from XD
activities.activity_description: Analyze XD aggregate-counter module, port aggregation logic (sum, average, min, max) to a consumer, expose metrics via Micrometer, and map configuration.
Unit tests for aggregation functions, integration tests verifying metric updates.

activities.activity_name: Gauge Sink Module - Port from XD
activities.activity_description: Analyze XD gauge module, port gauge value tracking logic to a consumer, expose as Micrometer Gauge, and map configuration.
Unit tests for gauge updates, integration tests verifying metric exposure.

activities.activity_name: Rich-Gauge Sink Module - Port from XD
activities.activity_description: Analyze XD rich-gauge module (which supports multiple values and labels), port to a consumer exposing rich metrics via Micrometer, and map configuration.
Unit tests for multi-value gauge handling, integration tests verifying metric exposure with tags.

activities.activity_name: Flink Processor Module - Design and Implementation
activities.activity_description: Design the Flink processor architecture, implement a Spring Cloud Stream processor that embeds a Flink DataStream job, integrate Flink ML libraries for streaming machine learning abstractions (e.g., feature engineering, model inference), handle configuration for Flink execution environment, and implement serialization for model artifacts.

Write unit tests for Flink job construction, integration tests using an embedded Flink cluster (via Testcontainers or MiniCluster) to verify end-to-end stream processing with ML operators, and performance baseline tests.
Test interoperability of modules in a simulated streaming pipeline (e.g., Kinesis source -> Flink processor -> metric sinks), verify configuration compatibility, and test deployment scenarios.

Write Asciidoc documentation for each module (configuration reference, usage examples), create sample applications demonstrating each sink and the Flink processor, and update the main Spring Cloud Stream reference guide.
Configure release profiles, sign artifacts, publish to Spring Maven repository, update version catalogs, and announce release.
